en.headline: Northern Link Spur Line Hong Kong section authorised for construction
en.dek: Transport secretary Chan May-po said the railway scheme had completed statutory procedures and works could start at any time, targeting simultaneous opening with the main line by 2034.
body: The Government today authorised the railway scheme for the Hong Kong section of the Northern Link Spur Line under the Railways Ordinance, completing a key statutory step.

Secretary for Transport and Logistics Chan May-po said the project is ready and construction can commence as soon as practicable. The spur line will connect San Tin Station on the main line to the new Huanggang Port, with new stations at Chau Tau and the Loop.

The roughly 6-kilometre underground line, about 5 km in Hong Kong and 1 km in Shenzhen, aims to open together with the Northern Link main line by 2034 or earlier. Travel time between San Tin and the new Huanggang Port is estimated at about 11 minutes.

Chan said no objections were received during the gazettal period, reflecting broad public support. The spur line will serve the San Tin Technopole and the Loop while strengthening cross-boundary links with Shenzhen.

zh.headline: 北環線支線香港段鐵路方案獲授權進行
zh.dek: 運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，法定程序已完成，工程可隨時起動，目標與主線於2034年或之前同步開通。
body: 政府今日按《鐵路條例》在憲報刊登通知，授權進行北環線支線香港段鐵路方案，完成關鍵法定程序。
運輸及物流局局長陳美寶表示，方案於刊憲期間無收到反對意見，項目已準備就緒，工程可隨時起動。支線將由主線新田站連接至新皇崗口岸，並在洲頭及河套設站。
整條約6公里地下鐵路（香港段約5公里、深圳段約1公里）目標與北環線主線於2034年或之前同步開通，新田至新皇崗口岸預計車程約11分鐘。
陳美寶指，北環線是推動北部都會區發展及助力香港融入國家發展的重要基建，亦是連接港深軌道網絡的標誌性工程。
